_comment: The DataEase datasets behind the Dashboards. Each is one SQL query (dataease/dashboards/sql/) that the read-only login gfm_dashboard_reader runs against the dashboards views of migrations 018 and 025. Complete weeks only: the week still being reported is always left out. Field names are the SQL column names; 'labels' gives the English name people see in DataEase. 'calculated' fields are worked out by DataEase after the zone, district and week filters (so a % of goal is right for any choice). Keep 'index' fixed once live: it makes the ids that charts refer to.
